title: Switch case block scope
starterCode:
let result = "none"
switch(1) {
  case 1:
    let msg = "hello"
    result = msg
    break
}
return result
solution:
let result = "none"
switch(1) {
  case 1:
    let msg = "hello"
    result = msg
    break
}
return result
hints: case is a block, let msg is scoped to it
